title: A general-position problem for planar line arrangements
summary: For all $δ>0$ and infinitely many $n \in \mathbb N$, we show that there exists a set $L$ of $n$ lines in $\mathbb R^2$ such that there are no intersecting quadruples, but for every subset $L' \subset L$ such that $|L'| \geq n^{\frac{4}{5}+δ}$, there exist three lines from $L'$ with a common point of intersection. This gives an improved bound for a dual form of a theorem of Balogh and Solymosi. As a consequence, we derive an improved lower bound for the Hadwiger-Debrunner number $HD_2(p,3)$.
